AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#355 @ 902c64a64156255ce9ce54147db896ac2142a954 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/0

Lens: AUD-SOL-P12-120, agent 120. Independent first full **T4** piece review: account/tenant program queries, access-refusal behavior, persisted workout editing and workout data; the grandfathered 1,716-line piece is within its 3,000-line ceiling. [Exact candidate and readiness](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/355#issuecomment-5975773604).

### B-355-1 — Programs silently exposes only the first 20 assignable clients

**File:** `src/api/programsApi.ts:319–342`, particularly the single `coachApi.getClients("active")` call at line 321; `useAssignableClients` treats the result as the complete roster without another-page state. [Owned API](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/902c64a64156255ce9ce54147db896ac2142a954/src/api/programsApi.ts#L319-L342), [owned hook](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/902c64a64156255ce9ce54147db896ac2142a954/src/hooks/usePrograms.ts#L76-L80).

**Counterexample:** a coach has 25 active clients; the backend `GET /coach/clients` defaults to `take=20` and supports `cursor`/`take`, but this caller supplies neither and never requests page two, so five valid clients cannot be selected or found for bulk assignment. [Backend controller contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ee55f814eb02b530e6578a168dc16c7ea7e2b07b/src/coach/coach.controller.ts#L63-L76), [backend default and cursor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ee55f814eb02b530e6578a168dc16c7ea7e2b07b/src/coach/coach.service.ts#L133-L161).

**Executed proof:** the real `programsApi.assignableClients()` over contract-shaped 20+5 pages returns only clients 0–19; the acceptance assertion fails specifically on the five missing IDs, while 96 controls pass, including all five original selected suites and the copied API controls. [CI lane 37341534822](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341534822/job/111869542984).

**Minimal fix rule:** fetch successive scoped roster pages using the existing cursor contract (or expose accurate load-more/search behavior rather than claiming completeness); deduplicate and sort the completed list, and surface a recoverable incomplete-load error if any page fails or progress stalls. Verify >20 clients, exact-page-boundary termination, duplicate IDs and second-page failure; do not replace the missing clients with an empty or apparently complete partial roster. [Affected implementation and contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/902c64a64156255ce9ce54147db896ac2142a954/src/api/programsApi.ts#L319-L342), [executed acceptance failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341534822/job/111869542984).

### Prior findings / review applicability

All 16 changed-file blobs are byte-identical to original Sol-approved #328 head `fb76721fa21476cf36595fcd861a6b5a07630516`; every piece diff/runtime/test addition was nevertheless read fully for boundary safety, including routes/idempotency, pagination, error recovery, flags, head adoption and access-refusal copy. This is a fresh piece verdict, not inherited blanket approval. [Original Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/328#issuecomment-5972137276), [piece scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/355).

Own original B-328-3/C-328-7 mapper closures and OR-112-18 hook/refusal behavior remain valid on unchanged code with passing current regression controls; original B-328-1/2/4 form/assignment UI belongs to later pieces, while B-328-5/6 history behavior is reviewed separately in #356. [Original dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/328#issuecomment-5964883401), [current P1 regression execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341534822/job/111869542984).

### CI / landing

Exact-candidate Typecheck/lint/test, CodeQL and both Analyze checks are green; the independent probe lane is intentionally red (1 failed / 96 passed), not a candidate-CI regression or infrastructure failure. No local heavy execution or real-device/server acceptance is claimed. [Candidate required CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37154708793/job/111295625849), [candidate Analyze](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37154708789), [independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37341534822).

**Recommended default:** a targeted P1 roster fix and failing-before/passing-after CI proof, then restack and obtain fresh exact-head dual verdicts; keep the four-piece land-as-one rule and operator-owned integrated main checks. No new product decision is needed, and this verdict is not merge/build/deployment authorization. [Piece landing rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/355#issuecomment-5975773604).
